earnings.title: Bristol Myers Squibb Reports Third Quarter Financial Results for 2026 and Raises Full-Year Revenue Outlook
highlights: GAAP EPS was $1.05 and non-GAAP EPS was $1.35; Both figures include net impact of $(0.58) due to Acquired IPRD charges and licensing income
Third quarter revenues increased 7% to $13.1 billion
Growth Portfolio revenues increased 12% to $7.7 billion
Growth Portfolio revenues of $7.7 billion increased 12%.

quotes.text: We delivered another quarter of double-digit growth in our Growth Portfolio, which increased 12% and reflects the continued momentum across our diversified portfolio.

outlook: Raising 2026 revenue guidance to a range of $49.75 billion to $50.25 billion; Updating non-GAAP EPS range to $6.35 to $6.55, inclusive of a $(0.60) per share net impact from Acquired IPRD charges and licensing income
Bristol Myers Squibb is increasing its full-year, non-GAAP revenue guidance from a range of approximately $49.0 billion to $50.0 billion to a range of approximately $49.75 billion to $50.25 billion.
Full-year other income/(expense) is now expected to be ~$650 million of expense, due to favorable net interest.
Non-GAAP EPS is being updated to an anticipated range of $6.35 - $6.55, which is inclusive of a $(0.60) impact from Acquired IPRD and licensing income.

items.heading: Increased pricing pressure and other restrictions in the U.S. and abroad continue to negatively affect our revenues and profit margins.

In July 2025, the OBBBA was enacted which, among other things, aims to achieve efficiencies in U.S. federal government healthcare spending over the next decade, primarily within Medicaid. We are continuing to assess the full scope of this legislation and its potential commercial implications, and it is possible that these changes may impact our cash flows and results of operations.

We may experience difficulties or delays in the development and commercialization of new products. Our ability to replace revenue from products that lose patent protection is directly dependent on our ability to successfully develop and commercialize new products in a timely manner.
